title: Sum of squares
prompt: Return 1 squared + 2 squared + ... + n squared. For 3 that is 1 + 4 + 9 = 14. For 0, return 0.
hints: range(1, n + 1) counts from 1 up to n.
`for i in range(1, n + 1):` then `total += i * i`.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: range(a, b)
docs.what: The whole numbers from a up to but not including b. range(n) starts at 0.
